title: LIVE | Newscentre | Quad Leaders Meet In Manila After Two-Year Gap | CNBC TV18
text:
The Quad leaders have held their first summit in two years on the sidelines of the ASEAN Summit in Manila. US President Donald Trump praised his ties with PM Narendra Modi, calling him a 'tough man' during a photo opportunity. The meeting marks Trump's first-ever Quad leaders' summit and the first to be held outside a member country. The leaders last met in September 2024 in Delaware.

title: Trump At ASEAN Summit: US-Thailand Trade Deal, AI And Critical Minerals Take Centre Stage
text:
US President Donald Trump addressed Southeast Asian leaders at the ASEAN Summit in Manila, announcing a new trade agreement with Thailand and pushing for stronger cooperation on critical minerals, rare earths, energy, technology and defence.

Trump also touted $22.2 trillion in investment commitments to the United States, highlighted the Alaska LNG project, and reaffirmed Washington's support for its Indo-Pacific allies. He discussed the Cambodia-Thailand peace agreement, growing US-Philippines defence ties and America's ambitions in artificial superintelligence.

Nvidia's board has ruled out bringing back co-founder Jensen Huang as chief executive, despite his offer to return to the top job following his resignation last week.

"The Nvidia board unanimously accepted his resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO," Chairman Harvey Jones said during an earnings call on Tuesday.
